reviewers.summary: The session-change invalidation and Hangar navigation test findings from the previous round are addressed. The portfolio row-to-summary behavior and executive `/work` state remain insufficiently tested.

findingList.message: The required `executive_portfolio_table_contract` test does not verify that a row opens its matching scoped read-only case summary through App.

evidence.codePathTraced: `executive_portfolio_table_contract` renders `ExecutivePortfolio` with a mock callback and asserts that clicking a row passes `case-001`. It does not exercise App navigation or verify that the matching scoped read-only summary opens.
evidence.failureScenario: If App navigation opens the wrong case summary or fails to render one, this test still passes.

findingList.message: The required `role route navigation` test still does not cover executive `/work` behavior.

evidence.codePathTraced: `role route navigation` signs in as an executive and checks the `/portfolio` state; it never navigates to `/work` or asserts the denial message and absence of worklist data.
evidence.failureScenario: If executive `/work` displays worklist data or omits `This page is not part of your workspace`, this test still passes.

reviewers.summary: The session-change request invalidation and executive Hangar coverage are addressed in this round. The portfolio row-to-summary navigation and executive `/work` test gaps from the previous review remain.

findingList.message: The portfolio table test still does not verify row navigation through App to the matching scoped read-only case summary.

evidence.codePathTraced: `executive_portfolio_table_contract` renders `ExecutivePortfolio` with a mock callback and checks that clicking a row calls it with `case-001`. It does not exercise App navigation or assert that the matching scoped read-only summary opens.
evidence.failureScenario: If App navigation opens the wrong case summary or fails to show one, this component-only test still passes.

findingList.message: The role route navigation test still does not cover the executive `/work` behavior required by the acceptance criterion.

evidence.codePathTraced: `role route navigation` signs in an executive and checks `/portfolio`, but does not navigate to `/work` or assert the workspace denial state and absence of worklist data.
evidence.failureScenario: If executive `/work` displays worklist data or omits `This page is not part of your workspace`, the test still passes.

reviewers.summary: The latest changes invalidate pending portfolio requests during ordinary session changes and extend the Hangar test for executive navigation. The portfolio row-to-summary behavior and executive `/work` route behavior remain insufficiently tested.

findingList.message: The required portfolio table test still does not verify that selecting a row opens its matching scoped read-only case summary.

evidence.codePathTraced: `executive_portfolio_table_contract` renders `ExecutivePortfolio` with a mock callback. Clicking the row verifies only that the callback receives `case-001`; it does not exercise App navigation or verify that the matching scoped read-only summary opens.
evidence.failureScenario: If App routes the row to the wrong case or fails to render its summary, this test still passes.

findingList.message: The required executive `/work` behavior remains untested in `role route navigation`.

evidence.codePathTraced: `role route navigation` checks executive sign-in to `/portfolio` but does not navigate to `/work` or assert the workspace-denial state and absence of worklist data.
evidence.failureScenario: If executive `/work` shows worklist data or omits `This page is not part of your workspace`, the test still passes.
